title: Historic Yellow Palaces
description: Admiring the striking Baroque facade and elegant grand staircases of Hellbrunn Palace, a location steeped in Salzburg's rich history and cinematic charm.
altText: A symmetrical front view of a grand, bright yellow Baroque palace with a grey shingled roof, green shutters, and a central double staircase.

title: Solar Timekeeping
description: Admiring a beautifully detailed, sun-drenched fresco sundial adorning a vibrant yellow facade in the historic palace grounds.
altText: A close-up shot of a decorative, fan-shaped sundial painted on a bright yellow building gable under a clear blue sky.

title: Honoring a Master
description: Pausing at Mozartplatz to take in the historic monument dedicated to Salzburg's most famous musical son.
altText: A tall green bronze statue of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart standing on a stone pedestal in front of classic European apartment buildings.

title: Residenzplatz Grandeur
description: Watching the powerful fountains dance in the main square, framed by the towering domes of the Salzburg Cathedral.
altText: A large, ornate stone fountain featuring carved horses and figures spraying water, with historic building facades and cathedral domes in the background.

title: Hidden Courtyard Details
description: Stumbling upon a beautifully patterned geometric star door tucked away in a quiet, rustic stone alleyway.
altText: A rustic stone wall with a dark green arched doorway featuring a prominent red, white, and brown geometric star pattern.

title: Salzburg's Skyline
description: Looking out over a sea of grey rooftops and elegant turquoise spires that define this stunning UNESCO World Heritage cityscape.
altText: A high-angle panoramic view of Salzburg's old town, showcasing multiple churches with distinct green copper domes and spires under a bright sky.

title: Baroque Splendour
description: Marveling at the breathtaking, ornate gold detailing and monumental altarpieces inside Salzburg's historic St Peter's Abbey.
altText: The grand interior of a Baroque church, showcasing white and turquoise walls filled with intricate gold decorations, towering altars, and religious statues.

title: Sculpted Entrances
description: Admiring the stunningly detailed, heavy bronze doors that guard the entrances to the city's ancient sacred spaces.
altText: A close-up shot of a pair of large, dark weathered bronze doors featuring intricate relief sculptures of tall wild plants and flowers, set within a stone archway.

title: Grand Courtyards
description: Exploring the sweeping, multi-storey courtyards of Salzburg's historic university buildings, complete with a central stone fountain.
altText: A wide view of a grand white European courtyard building with rows of windows, a painted sundial above an archway, and a tall green church spire in the background.

title: Old Town Lanes
description: Strolling through the bustling, narrow shopping streets of the historic centre, framed perfectly by hanging signs and distant clock towers.
altText: A vertical view looking down a narrow, crowded European shopping street flanked by pastel-coloured buildings, leading towards a white clock tower with a green dome.

title: At Mozart's Residence
description: Stepping through the historic stone archway of the Mozart Wohnhaus, where the musical genius lived and composed for many years.
altText: A close-up vertical shot of a grand stone archway with a heavy wooden door, topped by a sign reading "MOZART WOHNHAUS" beneath a window with grey shutters.
